# Portfolio Project Instructions

This repository contains a 3D portfolio project for showcasing professional work and skills.

## Project Overview
Build an interactive 3D website using modern web technologies to display portfolio items, resume, and contact information in an engaging 3D environment.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: React with TypeScript
- **3D Library**: Three.js
- **Build Tool**: Vite
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS

## Development Workflow
- Install dependencies: `npm install`
- Start development server: `npm run dev`
- Build for production: `npm run build`
- Preview build: `npm run preview`

## Conventions
- Use functional components with hooks
- Name component files in PascalCase (e.g., `PortfolioScene.tsx`)
- Organize 3D objects and scenes in separate modules under `src/scenes/`
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow React best practices for performance

## Key Files
- [README.md](README.md) - Project description
- `src/App.tsx` - Main application component
- `src/scenes/` - 3D scene components
- `public/` - Static assets

When working on 3D features, ensure compatibility with Three.js best practices and optimize for performance.
